pin_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to pin in memory per table (0 = no limit). Set to a positive integer to pin up to N pages.

pin_on_first_access.description: If true, automatically pin a table’s pages in memory on first access (after restart or cache flush).

pin_tables.description: List of table patterns (schema.table or schema.*) to automatically pin. Supports wildcards like `*`.

items.description: A table name pattern (e.g., 'public.logs', 'analytics.*') to pin in memory.

min_free_memory_mb.description: Minimum free RAM (in MB) that must remain after pinning; prevents system OOM.

max_pages_per_table.description: Maximum number of pages to pin per table. 0 means no per-table limit.

log_level.description: Log verbosity for pgfincore messages. Options: DEBUG5, DEBUG4, ..., LOG, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR.

unpin_on_checkpoint.description: If true, unpin tables after each checkpoint to reduce memory pressure over time.

exclude_tables.description: List of table patterns to *exclude* from automatic pinning, even if matched by pin_tables.

items.description: A table name pattern (e.g., 'pg_catalog.*, system_logs') to never pin.

shared_preload_libraries.description: PostgreSQL shared libraries to load at startup. Must include 'pgfincore'. Do not remove unless replacing the module.
